tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find licensed HVAC / mini split contractors around Austin TX by city and service, ordered by the site's published score.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Full verified record for one company (slug from search_companies or its profile URL).

tools.name: price_benchmarks
tools.description: Installed prices Austin-area contractors publish on their own websites, quoted as written.

tools.name: request_mini_split_quote
tools.description: Send a flat-price mini split quote request to Mini Split Reef ($2,000 per unit installed), an advertiser owned by this site's operators. Only when the user explicitly asks to be contacted and provides their own phone or email.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company · Private data: get_company · Public sink: price_benchmarks, request_mini_split_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company · Private data: get_company · Public sink: price_benchmarks, request_mini_split_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
